description: Our standard BRD format. Agent 1 (BRD Analyst) maps every customer BRD onto these fields, flags what is missing, and the analyst completes it before it is finalised for dashboard design.

statuses.inferred: Derived by the AI from the customer BRD - confirm with the customer
statuses.missing: Not in the customer BRD - ask the customer
statuses.assumed: Missing in the customer BRD - AI suggestion accepted as an assumption
statuses.confirmed: Entered or confirmed by the analyst

fields.label: Project name
fields.guidance: Short name of the reporting project.

fields.label: Client / business unit
fields.guidance: Customer organisation or business unit that owns the dashboards.

fields.label: Industry domain
fields.guidance: ecommerce, retail, finance, BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare, ...

fields.label: Document version
fields.guidance: Version of the customer BRD, e.g. 1.2.

fields.label: BRD owner
fields.guidance: Person or role accountable for the requirements.

fields.label: Business sponsor
fields.guidance: Executive who sponsors and signs off the project.

fields.label: Target BI platform
fields.guidance: Tableau, Power BI, or TBD. The HTML mockup is platform neutral.

fields.label: Business objective
fields.guidance: One or two sentences: what decisions the dashboards must support.

fields.label: Current state / pain points
fields.guidance: How reporting is done today and what is wrong with it.

fields.label: Success criteria
fields.guidance: Measurable outcomes that show the project worked.

fields.label: In scope
fields.guidance: Business areas, dashboards and data covered.

fields.label: Out of scope
fields.guidance: What is explicitly excluded.

fields.label: Stakeholders
fields.guidance: Every user group of the dashboards.

fields.label: Data sources
fields.guidance: Systems or tables the dashboards read from.

fields.label: Data grain
fields.guidance: Lowest level of detail, e.g. order line, transaction, daily snapshot.

fields.label: History required
fields.guidance: How far back the data must go, e.g. 24 months.

fields.label: Data quality notes
fields.guidance: Known gaps, late data, unavailable fields.

fields.label: Reporting time grain
fields.guidance: day, week, month, quarter or year.

fields.label: Default date range
fields.guidance: e.g. last 12 months, fiscal year to date.

fields.label: Global filters
fields.guidance: Fields users must be able to filter every dashboard by, e.g. Month, Region.

fields.label: Currency & number formats
fields.guidance: e.g. INR with lakh / crore, percentages to one decimal.

fields.label: KPI catalogue
fields.guidance: Every KPI used on any dashboard, with its business definition.

fields.label: Dashboards
fields.guidance: One row per dashboard. KPIs is a comma-separated list of KPI names from section 7.

fields.label: Visual requirements
fields.guidance: One row per chart. Dashboard must match a dashboard name above.

fields.label: Refresh schedule
fields.guidance: How often dashboards must refresh, e.g. daily 6 AM IST.

fields.label: Performance
fields.guidance: e.g. every dashboard loads in under 5 seconds.

fields.label: Security & access
fields.guidance: Who can see what: row-level security, roles, SSO.

fields.label: Branding & design
fields.guidance: Corporate colours, logo, style guide.

fields.label: Devices
fields.guidance: Desktop, tablet, mobile.

fields.label: Timeline / milestones
fields.guidance: Key dates: mockup review, UAT, go-live.

fields.label: Acceptance criteria
fields.guidance: What must be true for the customer to accept the dashboards.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.guidance: Anything interpreted rather than stated.

fields.label: Open questions
fields.guidance: Items still pending with the customer.

fields.label: Sign-off
fields.guidance: Approvers of the final BRD.
